label: heritage_listing
question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the occasions on which the building itself was placed on a heritage inventory, a national register or a landmark list, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Ba lần niêm yết di sản của chính tòa nhà ở ba cấp khác nhau nên phải liệt kê đủ.
criterion: the building itself is listed on a heritage inventory, the National Register or as a National Historic Landmark (a listing of the wider district does not count)

gold_events.text: Building listed on the District of Columbia Inventory of Historic Sites
Building listed on the National Register of Historic Places
Building designated a National Historic Landmark

label: theft
question: How many calendar years passed from the theft in which Dean Carignan took part to the overnight theft between April 29 and April 30 that was later lost in the mail?
why_needs_multiple: Hai vụ trộm kim đồng hồ đã nêu tên (cùng nhãn theft), hỏi khoảng cách năm, không hỏi thứ tự.

gold_events.text: Carignan and a fellow student access the clock and steal the hands
Clock hands stolen overnight April 29-30, later lost in the mail
